claims.claim: Nikolic coordinated the Jan. 31, 2011 meeting and the surviving email says he would come with 'bill'.
Gates testified that Nikolic arranged his first dinner with Epstein and that the Jan. 31 dinner itself was Gates, Nikolic and Epstein.
Gates testified that Nikolic ultimately told him he was involving Epstein in Nikolic's exit discussions.
The July 2013 Epstein-to-self drafts are not proof that Gates received them or that every assertion in them was true.
Gates rejected the proposition that Nikolic and Epstein had conspired before the first dinner to draw him in.
claims.confidence: P4 testimony; not an independent factual adjudication
